resources.string: Welcome back! Your island earned %1$s coins. Tap to dismiss.
Produces automatically. Every 10 levels doubles this building’s output.
Unlock this neighboring tile to expand your island.

Tap a tile to unlock or upgrade it. Drag the island to rotate; pinch to zoom. Use Land to choose buildings from a list.

Your island produces wood, stone and coins automatically, including up to 8 hours away. Workers and research increase production.

Listening in a foreign language adds energy for a ×3 production boost and 1 insight per 5 minutes. Successful vocabulary reviews earn 1 insight per card each day, up to 40. Insight can halve research material costs. Learning is a bonus; buildings remain usable without it.

The portal opens after 12 tiles and 10,000 coins produced. A voyage resets this island in exchange for stars and a new world style. Stars permanently boost production. Podcasts and saved vocabulary are unaffected.
Each additional worker adds 15% to all production. Up to five workers are shown on the island.
Research increases production. Insight from listening and reviews offers an optional discount.
Travel to another world style and rebuild with a permanent production bonus.
Explore 12 tiles and produce 10,000 coins to open the portal.
Preserved from your aquarium: %1$d coins transferred and %2$d collected species/tier relics recorded. Your original save is kept.
Buildings, workers, research, wood, stone and coins reset. Insight, listening progress, legacy relics and permanent stars are kept. Your podcasts and vocabulary stay saved.
3D island. Drag to rotate and pinch to zoom. Use the Land button to choose a tile from an accessible list.
The 3D view could not start. Your world is safe; use Land to keep building.
Not enough resources yet. Your island keeps producing.
